description: This file defines a Unity MonoBehaviour class 'indoortouch' that manages touch interactions for indoor navigation, activating and deactivating GameObjects based on user touch input and raycast hit results.

classes.name: indoortouch
classes.description: A Unity MonoBehaviour for handling touch input to toggle visibility of indoor navigation objects.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes the array of GameObjects and assigns specific objects to variables.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Checks for touch input and performs raycasting to determine which object was touched, then updates visibility of objects based on the touched element.
